fields.label: Device Id
fields.description: Denormalized from the parent Offline Sync Batch so the (device_id, entity_type, reference_id) idempotency check is a single flat query across all batches, not a join.

fields.label: Reference Id
fields.description: The mobile app's own local-PK reference id for this entity, echoed back verbatim -- NOT globally unique on its own (only unique per device), see Offline Sync Batch.device_id for the other half of the idempotency key.

fields.label: FHIR Id
fields.description: The canonical id assigned to the created/updated record (e.g. the Encounter.name for an Assessment row) -- this is the SAME id echoed in status.fhirId, member-assessment-history.encounterId, and the FHIR Encounter resource's own id. Never regenerate a different id for the same entity across these three surfaces.

fields.label: Payload Json
fields.description: The exact item payload `create` built this row from, so the reconciliation sweep (spice_next_core.reconciliation.reconcile_failed_items) can replay a Failed row's processing later without the mobile device having to resend it -- the legacy offline-service had no equivalent of this and no sweep job, which is the root cause this whole migration started from (see Offline Sync Batch's own doc comment).
